name: nodedex
description: NodeDex — your project's decision history, for AI agents (MCP server): decisions with their why, dead-ends with their why-not, constraints and causal chains — extracted automatically from agent conversations into a local graph the agent checks before proposing. A different job than fact/preference memory; run both.
